what: One-finger chord player: a song's chords on the black keys, a scale-matched melody on the white keys (ASSIST lights the good notes). 17 songs, each with its own sounds and drums; twelve drum styles; a 4-bar looper; a runner that runs while you play, with missions and characters to unlock.
author: swtdr34mz (based on Blop by Obsimo)
